purpose: Can a 4B narration model load in the product's wllama blob path on this box?
finding: The fifth blob fetch fails in any shard order once the page holds ~1.9 GiB (2043146272 bytes) of model Blobs. The limit is aggregate, not per-file and not storage quota (navigator.storage.estimate quota 10 GiB, usage 0).
productImpact: The product loads semantic 0.6B (396705472 B) and narration in the same page. A 4B narration arm would need 2.89 GiB of Blobs, over the cap; even a 2B narration model plus semantics would sit at the cap. Under wllama 3.8.1 blob loading the practical narration ceiling is the current 1.5B/1.7B class.
conclusion: 4B route closed on this stack. Remaining routes: targeted fine-tune of a 1.5B/1.7B with data built from the current narration projection, or accept the recorded G6 failure.
